fields.name: Catfolk
fields.desc: Catfolk are a social and active people of natural grace and obsessive curiosity, resembling bipedal, feline humanoids with tails, cat-like ears, and fur. They are equally comfortable wandering in far-off regions, wallowing in the heart of the largest cities, or delving into the lair of forgotten horrors.

fields.name: Basteti
fields.desc: Basteti are the adored children of the cat goddess. These mischievous catfolk turn curiosity into a cultural obsession, adoring new experiences, collecting interesting artifacts, and meeting unique strangers.

fields.name: Nkosi
fields.desc: The Nkosi are the chosen people of the Returned Titan and serve as the protectors of their homeland. Nkosi consider their ability to change shape to be a divine gift and distrust lycanthropes.

fields.name: Gnoll
fields.desc: The average gnoll views work and self-sufficiency with distaste. Gnolls who possess the will to face danger make excellent adventurers.

fields.name: Civilized Gnoll
fields.desc: As a civilized gnoll, you are well-fed and enjoy the comforts that your more rural cousins can only dream of. You were valued as a mercenary, a temple guard, or simply a thug.

fields.name: Savage Gnoll
fields.desc: As a savage gnoll, you are in touch with your animal side and understand the ways of nature. Your tribe has been raiding the desert or the plains since generations ago.

fields.name: Desert Gnoll
fields.desc: As a desert gnoll, you use the terrain to your advantage. You can endure heat and dehydration far beyond the limits of most humanoids, making you a superlative hunter, raider, or caravan guard.

fields.name: Necropolis Gnoll
fields.desc: As a necropolis gnoll, you spent most of your life among tombs, where the only other living creatures were members of your tribe. You're adept at avoiding traps and the powers of rot and undeath.

fields.name: Jinnborn
fields.desc: Native to the deepest deserts, the jinnborn claim they were the first mortals to walk the world. Descended from powerful elemental creatures called the Jinn, the jinnborn manifest gifts through their lineage that help them survive their harsh home environment.

fields.name: Speaker Jinnborn
fields.desc: Speaker jinnborn bear the mark of their jinni patron, and the world must stand up and take notice. They are the guides, elders, and leaders of their tribes, as well as scouts and seekers of paths.

fields.name: Shaper Jinnborn
fields.desc: The Shaper jinnborn channel the elemental power of their tribe's siraati. Shapers form the majority of a tribe's warriors and protectors.

fields.name: Minotaur
fields.desc: The proud minotaurs of the southern lands seek to reclaim their ancestral glories from the ruins of the past. The bull-folk are imposing and powerful, with a well-earned reputation for ferocity that borders on monstrous.

fields.name: Tosculi
fields.desc: The tosculi are insectoid humanoids, operating under a shared consciousness. A fearsome and ruthless insectoid queen rules each hive city. Hiveless tosculi are outcasts who possess individualism and can become adventurers.

fields.name: Heru
fields.desc: Ravenfolk, called heru, are valued and honored citizens in most realms. Most worship the falcon-headed god, with the vast majority residing in his temples.

fields.name: Lizardfolk
fields.desc: The lizardfolk are a little-known race, but they have existed in the world for untold ages. Those lizardfolk who become adventurers form strong attachments to their companions.

fields.name: Murkscale
fields.desc: The murkscale lizardfolk dwell deep within the marshes, swamps, and fens of the world, far from the dwellings of the hapless, soft, warm-blood races.

fields.name: Velesborn
fields.desc: Harkening from the deepest, darkest jungles, the velesborn believe they are the true children of the Great Serpent, who has blessed them with natural grace and innate toughness.

fields.name: Ramag
fields.desc: The enigmatic ramag thrive in the heart of a land once ruled by an empire of titans. The race's natural affinity for manipulating magic made the ramag essential to tending a vast web of magical energy.

fields.name: Subek
fields.desc: The kindly, scholarly subek come from a river-based culture, known for advising others and lending their physical and intellectual prowess to local projects. During flood season, however, the subek become violent and territorial.

fields.name: Trollkin
fields.desc: Descended from fey, immortal, and other monstrous races, trollkin are seldom welcome among the civilized races. As a result, most trollkin live in isolated septs or tribal settlements and subsist on hunting and raiding.

fields.name: Southern Trollkin
fields.desc: Southern trollkin have adapted to the harsh climates of the southern lands, from the scorching deserts to the humid jungles. They are often more integrated into local communities than their northern cousins.
